Deck Remodeling

Deck remodeling should rebuild the structure, flashing, and drainage before the surface. RT Signature Homes coordinates framing, decking, railings, and outdoor living features so the finished deck lasts and connects to the home.

Kitchen Remodeling

RT Signature Homes approaches kitchen remodeling as a balance of circulation, storage, work zones, lighting, materials, and construction reality. Every visible finish depends on decisions behind the walls and inside the cabinets.

Explore kitchen remodeling

Bathroom Remodeling

Bathrooms concentrate plumbing, ventilation, electrical work, tile, cabinetry, glass, and moisture control in a compact footprint. RT Signature Homes plans those systems together so the room performs as well as it looks.

Common questions

Before you request a consultation

What kinds of projects are a fit for RT Signature Homes?

The team evaluates qualifying Washington residential projects including whole-home remodeling, kitchens, bathrooms, additions, ADUs, custom homes, exterior improvements, flooring, and painting.

When should I request a consultation?

Reach out while you are defining the scope, priorities, investment expectations, and timing. Early context makes the first project conversation more useful.

Will the first conversation provide an instant project price?

Complex residential work requires information about the property, existing conditions, scope, selections, access, and schedule before a responsible recommendation can be made.

Transform Your Redmond Home With Thoughtful Remodeling Solutions

Home Remodeling in Redmond works best when it starts with how your home actually fits your life, whether you are in a Downtown Redmond townhome, an Education Hill family house, or a view property near Grass Lawn. RT Signature Homes reworks layout, lighting, and finishes together so a dated kitchen or tired primary suite becomes a space that feels current and genuinely easier to use every day.

No two Redmond homes are alike, from Overlake condos to established houses near Idylwood, so we tailor each project to the property rather than a template. We coordinate trades, selections, permits, and inspections carefully so the finished remodel feels custom and holds up to everyday Pacific Northwest living.

Whole-Home Remodeling Ideas for Modern and Timeless Interior Designs

The strongest ideas for Home Remodeling in Redmond give every room one cohesive design instead of a patchwork of updates. For owners modernizing a 1990s Education Hill home or refining a newer build near Overlake, we balance modern finishes with timeless materials so the result still looks right years from now, carrying flooring, cabinetry, and trim consistently throughout the house.

  • Open-concept kitchens built for gathering
  • Spa-inspired bathrooms and primary suites
  • Durable flooring, trim, and fresh paint
  • Smarter storage, built-ins, and lighting
  • A consistent material palette in every room

Home Renovation and Remodeling Solutions for Changing Household Needs

Households change, and Home Remodeling in Redmond should keep up, from adding a home office to creating a main-floor bedroom as a family grows. RT Signature Homes adapts the home you already have, improving flow, storage, and accessibility so it keeps working as your needs shift rather than forcing a move across the Eastside.

Room to grow

Added bedrooms, larger kitchens, and flexible living space that keep pace with a busy household.

Comfort for the long term

Main-floor suites, curbless showers, and safer layouts that support aging in place.

Work, hobbies, and flexibility

Home offices, bonus rooms, and organized storage that adapt as daily routines change.
